title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 10: Kujithamini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the wahusika with the right term, proves each point with a line or event from "Kisima cha Matumaini", and says what it does in the work.

floor.prerequisite: Answers comprehension questions from a passage.
floor.question: Jibu linatoka wapi?

representations: the class novela "Kisima cha Matumaini" with key pages marked
steps: Read the question and the term.
Find the part of the work.
Write the point with its evidence.
contexts: a school drama or poetry festival

board.say: Neema ana sifa gani, na tunajuaje?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes one point with its evidence and its importance in the frame.

misconceptions.ask: Kazi hii inafuatilia tatizo la nani?
misconceptions.repair: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye kazi inamhusu tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho.

listen_for: ni jasiri kwa sababu ni mhusika mzuri
misconceptions.ask: Ni kitendo gani kinaonyesha sifa hii?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sifa ithibitishwe kwa kitendo cha mhusika katika kazi.
Sifa za kitabia ni kama ukarimu, uchoyo, ujasiri; si urefu.
Tunajifunza kuepuka tabia mbaya kwa kuona matokeo yake.

checks.question: Mhusika mkuu katika "Kisima cha Matumaini" ni nani?
Neema ni jasiri. Ni ushahidi upi unaothibitisha?
checks.answer: alienda kwa chifu peke yake kuripoti wizi wa maji
